title: AMD vs. Nvidia: The AI Supercycle Is Big Enough for Both. Here's the Better Buy. - The Motley Fool
summary: AMD vs. Nvidia: The AI Supercycle Is Big Enough for Both. Here's the Better Buy. The Motley Fool
body:
The artificial intelligence (AI) boom is creating massive winners, but not every stock riding this wave will deliver the same type of returns for investors.

Nvidia (NVDA +0.87%) and Advanced Micro Devices (AMD +3.36%) are two of the biggest names powering the AI revolution, and both are seeing explosive demand for their chips. While the AI supercycle may be big enough for both companies to thrive, one stock still stands out as the better buy right now.

The reason comes down to how each company is positioned within the AI ecosystem and how much of that opportunity is already priced into their stocks.
